svg.title: K04 · Running is not reachable: the setup
svg.desc: The cast of scenario 04: visitor (asks every 2 s,, prints a result); Service tools (finds Pods, by their labels); Pods tools (2) (IT-Tools, a developer toolbox). Your mission: Every Pod is Running. Why does every request fail?
